list.rawQuery:
with real_dg as (select dg.id as diagram_id, dg.user_id from diagrams dg join users u on u.id = dg.user_id
            where not dg.scratch and u.username not like 'claude-test%'),
sit as (select d.id as sitting_id, d.user_id, d.diagram_id, min(s.created_at) as started, max(s.created_at) as ended,
               row_number() over w as nth, lead(min(s.created_at)) over w as next_started
        from discussions d join real_dg r on r.diagram_id = d.diagram_id
        join statements s on s.discussion_id = d.id and s.kind::text = 'turn'
        join speakers sp on sp.id = s.speaker_id
        where not d.synthetic and d.kind::text = 'chat'
        group by d.id, d.user_id, d.diagram_id having bool_or(sp.type::text = 'Subject')
        window w as (partition by d.user_id order by min(s.created_at))),
msg as (select s.id as statement_id, s.discussion_id as sitting_id, s.turn_id, s.created_at, s.text, s.prompt_version,
               case sp.type::text when 'Subject' then 'person' else 'coach' end as who,
               row_number() over (partition by s.discussion_id order by s."order", s.id) as pos
        from statements s join speakers sp on sp.id = s.speaker_id join sit on sit.sitting_id = s.discussion_id
        where s.kind::text = 'turn'),
turn as (select m.turn_id, m.sitting_id, m.statement_id as reply_id, m.created_at as at, m.text,
                coalesce(m.prompt_version, 'none') as prompt_version,
                row_number() over (partition by m.sitting_id order by m.pos) as idx
         from msg m where m.who = 'coach' and m.turn_id is not null)
select min(t.at) as time, 'Prompt version ' || t.prompt_version || ' first served' as text
from turn t group by t.prompt_version

panels.title: Share of coach turns that wrote to the record, by week and prompt version
panels.description: Coach turns that changed a person, event, pair-bond or emotion in the record (a record tool that was not refused, or a coach row in the change log), as a share of all coach turns that week, one line per prompt version. r as (select t.*, regexp_replace(t.text, '\[\[[a-z_]+:[^|\]]+(\|([^\]]*))?\]\]', '\2', 'g') as clean
      from turn t where $__timeFilter(t.at) and t.prompt_version in (${prompt_version:sqlstring})),
shape as (select r.turn_id, r.prompt_version, r.idx, r.at,
                 case when btrim(r.clean) = '' then 0 else array_length(regexp_split_to_array(btrim(r.clean), '\s+'), 1) end as words,
                 (select count(*) from regexp_matches(r.clean, '[.?!]+(\s|$)', 'g')) as sentences,
                 length(r.clean) - length(replace(r.clean, '?', '')) as questions,
                 (r.clean ~ '(^|\n)\s*([-*•]|\d+[.\x29])\s' or r.clean ~ '(^|\n)[A-Z][A-Za-z ]{0,30}:\s') as form_like,
                 (select count(*) from regexp_matches(r.text, '\[\[[a-z_]+:', 'g')) as chips
          from r),
pw as (select m.turn_id, sum(case when btrim(m.text) = '' then 0 else array_length(regexp_split_to_array(btrim(m.text), '\s+'), 1) end) as words
       from msg m where m.who = 'person' and m.turn_id is not null group by 1)
select t.prompt_version as "prompt version", case when t.idx <= 5 then '1-5' when t.idx <= 15 then '6-15' else '16 and later' end as "turn in the sitting", count(*) as replies,
       percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by t.words) as "median words",
       percentile_cont(0.9) within group (order by t.words) as "90th percentile words",
       round(avg(t.sentences), 1) as "sentences", round(avg(t.questions), 2) as "question marks",
       case when max(vp.people) >= 30 then round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where t.form_like) / count(*), 1) end as "form-like (%)",
       round(avg(t.chips), 2) as "chips per reply",
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by t.words::float8 / nullif(pw.words, 0)))::numeric, 2) as "words over the person's"
from shape t join vp on vp.prompt_version = t.prompt_version left join pw on pw.turn_id = t.turn_id
group by 1, 2 order by 1, min(t.idx)

        join statements s on s.discussion_id = d.id and s.kind::text = 'turn'

        where not d.synthetic and d.kind::text = 'chat'
        group by d.id, d.user_id, d.diagram_id having bool_or(sp.type::text = 'Subject')
        window w as (partition by d.user_id order by min(s.created_at))),

                 (select count(*) from regexp_matches(r.text, '\[\[[a-z_]+:', 'g')) as chips
